summary.text: Joe Patterson is a Republican member of the California State Assembly from District 5 who took office on December 5, 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Patterson described himself as a city councilman and small business owner who, with his wife Colleen, is raising four children, and said he has served on several nonprofit boards, including the Rocklin Public Safety Foundation.

He listed his priorities as protecting quality of life, addressing the cost of living and keeping communities safe, and said he is passionate about jobs and the economy, public safety, utilities and education.
Patterson was re-elected on November 5, 2024, defeating Democrat Neva Parker, 62.0 percent to 38.0 percent.
In the June 2, 2026 primary he received 60.1 percent and advanced to a general-election rematch with Parker.

For 2025 and 2026 he was vice chair of the Housing and Community Development Committee and the Utilities and Energy Committee, and a member of the Budget, Health, and Privacy and Consumer Protection committees.
